method.format_validity: Post-hoc validation against the submit_review schema: required top-level keys and types, at most one candidate, exact candidate keys/types, valid locations, and rejected_leads as objects with lead and reason string fields.
method.semantic_match: Only the selected candidates[0] is scored. A hit requires matching the dataset-designated vulnerability/root cause; matching CWE or only mentioning a related file/parameter is insufficient. Correct issues in rejected_leads do not count as top-1 hits.
